@RestController class Accounts { @PreAuthorize("@policy.visible(#accountId)") @GetMapping("/accounts/{accountId}") public Account show(@PathVariable String accountId) { return accounts.findById(accountId); } }

@RestController class Accounts { @Secured("ROLE_ADMIN") @GetMapping("/administration/accounts") public Object adminList() { return accounts.findAll(); } @GetMapping("/accounts/export") public Object exportList() { return accounts.findAll(); } }

@RestController @Secured("ROLE_ADMIN") class Accounts { @GetMapping("/accounts") public Object list() { return accounts.findAll(); } @GetMapping("/accounts/export") public Object exportList() { return accounts.findAll(); } }

[ApiController] class Invoices { [HttpGet("{invoiceId}")] public object Read(string invoiceId) { return context.Invoices.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Id == invoiceId && x.OwnerId == User.Id); } }

[ApiController] [Authorize] class Invoices { [HttpGet("admin")] public object Admin() { return context.Invoices.FirstOrDefault(); } [AllowAnonymous] [HttpGet("export")] public object Export() { return context.Invoices.FirstOrDefault(); } }
